# Flyer Maker

Flyer maker: design a flyer for your event, sale or business with the headline, date, place and offer in plain view, on a portrait page ready to print or post.

## What it does
Give the headline, the date, the place and the details. Claude tells you the price and designs the flyer.

**How the files are made:** each flyer is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install flyer-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Flyer Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/flyer-maker/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each flyer uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The flyers show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_flyer_models` | Models for flyers with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_flyer_cost` | Exact price of one flyer before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_flyer` | Starts one flyer in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_flyer` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a flyer for a yard sale on Saturday at 9 am"
- "Design a flyer for a yoga class every Tuesday evening"
- "Create a flyer for the grand opening of my coffee shop"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the flyer (the headline, details, theme and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
